basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: GTM Strategist & RevOps Builder | Built the AI GTM Data Layer at LumApps | 3× Founder | MBA
basics.summary: Cross-functional operator who bridges strategy, data, and execution. At LumApps I built the single source of truth for GTM: a temporal knowledge graph unifying Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo and product-usage signals into one auditable store, feeding pipeline forecasting and executive reporting. Prior GTM ownership at Beekeeper: co-owned launches with Sales/PM/RevOps that shipped $1.5M+ in revenue, all with instrumentation to prove impact within a week. MBA (93.2%) and 3 AI products founded solo, each requiring end-to-end GTM design (positioning, funnel, activation, expansion). SQL-comfortable, developer-native, remote-native.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Designed AI Brain, the single source of truth for GTM: a temporal knowledge graph unifying Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, and product-usage signals into one auditable store. Feeds pipeline health, forecasting, and executive reporting; queryable directly (SQL/Cypher) so any team can dispute a metric with data instead of an opinion.

Own the AI outbound platform that Sales and RevOps depend on daily. Segmentation and personalization from CRM + product-usage data; instrumentation on top-of-funnel conversion, open rates, and approved-opportunity conversion. 2x conversions, $1M forecast quarterly.
Cross-functional with Sales, RevOps, Product, and Finance on rollout and outcomes. Report to C-level on what is working and what is not, with the query, not the summary.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.position: Senior Software Engineer (Technical Lead) & GTM Co-Owner
highlights: Co-owned cross-functional GTM launches with Sales, PM, and RevOps: Seasonal Templates, Re-ignite Revenue, Sentiment Analysis, Employee Lifecycle. Every launch shipped with instrumentation so we knew within a week if it moved pipeline.

Architected the Employee Referral System and ran its GTM end to end. Became the platform's top revenue channel: $1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR. Owned coverage, activation, and post-launch expansion in partnership with Sales leadership.

Built GenAI demo tooling that auto-produced personalized content per account from Salesforce data. Direct sales enablement impact; the same personalization playbook translated into email and outbound sequences.

Wrote SQL and warehouse queries daily to answer product and GTM questions myself before pulling an analyst. Built dashboards, computed conversion metrics, and diagnosed pipeline anomalies from raw data.

work.name: Tenity
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups for seed-to-VC decisions including GTM readiness, positioning, and forecast credibility.
Advised portfolio companies on PLG motions, top-of-funnel conversion, and building instrumentation to prove pipeline impact.

work.name: Obermatt
highlights: Bridged business and engineering on a financial-analytics product. Built roadmaps that improved retention; ran discovery with customers directly.
Directed a remote engineering team; introduced agile practices (productivity up 20%) and CI/CD (deployment times down 30%). Async-native operating.
